note: Set A is preferred because it captures all key engineering constraints (display sizes, brightness, dinner party rules) with fewer redundant claims than Set B. Set B includes trivial variations of the same size claims (e.g., extracting both 'minimum size' and 'minimum manufacturer stated display size' for both inches and centimeters), inflating the claim count without adding new information. Both sets are accurate and faithful to the text, but Set A is more concise.
